assessments.reasoning: Event 8d5bfd3345f444a696651ade90b87cb7, Mozilla media, MPL 1.1 governing revision 1, [3811,5160). The grant, express rights exclusions and first-distribution provision occur in this edition’s §2.1.

challenge.method: Tested pre-distribution activity, a trademark, a patent, and rights belonging only to a contributor against §§2.1 and 2.2.
challenge.results: First distribution is the stated timing trigger. Trademarks fall outside §2.1(a), patents receive separate treatment in §§2.1(b) and (d), and §2.2 has a different grantor and trigger.

limitations: Section 1.8.1 defines Licensable by the ability to grant rights, including subsequently acquired rights. Section 2.1(c) dates the grant to the Initial Developer’s first distribution of Original Code under this license. Sections 5 and 8 also limit application and continuation.
reasoning: MPL 1.1 §2.1(a) lists the seven acts and limits them to intellectual-property rights other than patent or trademark Licensable by the Initial Developer. It covers Original Code or portions with or without Modifications and/or as part of a Larger Work, subject to third-party claims.
